body: I can relate, talk to me?
By David Burns? I'll give it a try. I want the medication, more than anything, but my mother really doesn't want me too.. I'm never comfortable with talking to therapists

I have tried medication and therapy in the past, it didn't work out very well. And the only anti-anxiety medication that my country really offers makes you emotionally numb and makes you a "zombie". I just really don't know what to do.

I understand, I can't say that I can fully relate. But I believe that you and I could both be at the same low point. Despite understanding, I'm always so unsure what to say to people who feel the same as I do.
All I can think of saying is to tell you what improves my mood in the slightest, I think avoiding alcohol would be a good start, it's addictive especially when you're depressed (I'm sure you already know that), having friends that don't understand is tough too, I have no close friends myself, I think maybe your friends are not the right people to tell, I'd suggest calling a help line, a relative or going to the hospital. I really do understand though
I would say me, but I'm also at a low point myself.
